description: Converts dumbbell and barbell loads. The total is arithmetic for any lift. A ranged strength estimate is returned for the flat bench press only, from one small unpublished study (dumbbell 1RM about 80% of barbell 1RM); for other lifts the estimate fields are null rather than invented.

weight_kg.description: Dumbbell weight per hand, or the loaded barbell including the bar.

name: dumbbell_barbell_converter
title: Dumbbell to barbell converter
